overview: The Logistics Depot is the doctrinal freight hub of Sanctus Seru, where all cargo is screened, sorted, and distributed.
history: Built to centralize industrial and civic supply chains under Seru’s doctrine.
Purity-screened loading bays were added to prevent ideological contamination.
Resonance freight rails were introduced to stabilize arcane cargo movement.
Praetorian logistics officers were integrated to enforce decree compliance.
hooks: A freight rail destabilizes, threatening a resonance cascade.
A cargo stack reports a purity ward failure.
A Praetorian logistics officer requests assistance with a sealed shipment.
A crate of decree-approved goods goes missing.
